d:
Pichhle kuchh samay se lagatar rashtriy janta dal ki or se nitish kumar ko aarjedi ke sath aane ka ophar diya ja raha hai. ek bar phir rohini aachary ne kaha ki vah to unka chacha hain. jis tarah unke bete nishant kumar ke sath durvyavhar huaa hai, vaise men unko is par phaisla karna hai. rohini ne kaha ki chacha ke lie hamesha darvaja khula hai.
